description: Repairable surface for the Suchi Cancer Bot autoresearch loop. These are the ONLY files the agent is allowed to modify during experimentation.

files.description: System prompt for explain-mode responses (information-first educational answers)
files.notes: Changes affect tone, structure, and coverage of all explain-mode responses. Safety-critical sections (NEVER DO THIS, citation requirements) must not be weakened.
protectedStrings: If the user asks about stopping or changing their prescribed treatment, respond with: 'I cannot provide advice on stopping or changing prescribed treatment — this must be discussed with your doctor or oncologist.' Then end the response.

files.description: System prompt for navigate-mode responses (personal symptom support with warmth)
files.notes: Changes affect how the bot responds to personal symptom questions. The 4-step SAFE+USEFUL contract and India context must be preserved.

files.description: Structured checklist prompt for 'how to identify' cancer questions (4 mandatory sections)
files.notes: Defines the mandatory 4-section structure (warning signs, diagnostics, when to seek care, doctor questions). Minimum bullet counts and citation requirements are safety-critical.

files.description: RAG retrieval parameters: topK, reranker settings, scoring factors, expansion config
files.notes: Numeric tuning knobs for retrieval quality. Safe to experiment with — affects recall/precision tradeoff but not safety.

files.description: Chat routing thresholds, structured response patterns, budget limits, answer-first eligibility
files.notes: Patterns determine which queries get full structured responses vs answer-first. Budget values affect timeout behavior.

files.description: Language detection, supported locales, Hindi/Hinglish pattern matching, multilingual guidance
files.notes: Controls language routing and Hindi/Hinglish content depth. Safe to tune patterns for better Hindi query detection.

files.description: Medical disclaimer templates in 4 languages (en, hi, bh, mai) and insertion rules
files.notes: SAFETY-CRITICAL. Disclaimers are the last line of defense. Changes must preserve the non-removable, always-append behavior. Never weaken disclaimer language.

constraints.safetyInvariant: Safety module (safety.rules.ts, safety.service.ts) is NOT part of the repairable surface and must never be modified by the autoresearch loop.
constraints.evalRubricInvariant: Eval rubrics (eval/rubrics/rubrics.v1.json) are NOT part of the repairable surface. They define the scoring contract and must be modified only by humans.
constraints.databaseInvariant: Prisma schema and migrations are NOT part of the repairable surface.
constraints.maxRiskLevel: Files with risk=high require human approval before deployment. Files with risk=low can be auto-deployed after eval passes.
